// Auto-generated Code Vault for 'GearProfile' [Autolisp]

(defun c:drawgear (/ center radius num_teeth tooth_width tooth_height angle step)
  ; Define the center of the gear
  (setq center (getpoint "\nSpecify the center of the gear: "))
  
  ; Define the radius of the gear
  (setq radius (getreal "\nSpecify the radius of the gear: "))
  
  ; Define the number of teeth
  (setq num_teeth (getint "\nSpecify the number of teeth: "))
  
  ; Define the width and height of each tooth
  (setq tooth_width (getreal "\nSpecify the width of each tooth: "))
  (setq tooth_height (getreal "\nSpecify the height of each tooth: "))
  
  ; Calculate the angle between each tooth
  (setq angle (/ (* 360.0 num_teeth) num_teeth))
  
  ; Calculate the step for the while-loop
  (setq step (/ (* 2 pi) num_teeth))
  
  ; Start the polyline
  (command "pline")
  
  ; Initialize the angle for the while-loop
  (setq start_angle 0)
  
  ; Draw the gear profile using a while-loop
  (while (< start_angle (* 2 pi))
    ; Calculate the coordinates of the current point
    (setq x (+ (car center) (* radius (cos start_angle))))
    (setq y (+ (cadr center) (* radius (sin start_angle))))
    
    ; Add the current point to the polyline
    (command x y)
    
    ; Calculate the coordinates of the next point (tooth tip)
    (setq x_tooth (+ (car center) (* (+ radius tooth_height) (cos start_angle))))
    (setq y_tooth (+ (cadr center) (* (+ radius tooth_height) (sin start_angle))))
    
    ; Add the tooth tip to the polyline
    (command x_tooth y_tooth)
    
    ; Calculate the coordinates of the next point (tooth end)
    (setq x_tooth_end (+ (car center) (* (+ radius tooth_height) (cos (+ start_angle (/ angle 2))))))
    (setq y_tooth_end (+ (cadr center) (* (+ radius tooth_height) (sin (+ start_angle (/ angle 2))))))
    
    ; Add the tooth end to the polyline
    (command x_tooth_end y_tooth_end)
    
    ; Calculate the coordinates of the next point (root of next tooth)
    (setq x_root (+ (car center) (* radius (cos (+ start_angle angle)))))
    (setq y_root (+ (cadr center) (* radius (sin (+ start_angle angle)))))
    
    ; Add the root of the next tooth to the polyline
    (command x_root y_root)
    
    ; Increment the angle for the next iteration
    (setq start_angle (+ start_angle step))
  )
  
  ; Close the polyline
  (command "c")
)

(princ "\nType 'DRAWGEAR' to run the script.")
(princ)
